[EXPLICAÇÃO] Diógenes, O Cínico 😭 Dá pra falar mil coisas desse tipo que ele fez Quem foi Diógenes? • Diógenes foi um pensador da Grécia Antiga, viveu aproximadamente entre 412 a.C. e 323 a.C, e foi o maior expoente do Cinismo. • Sua imagem se consolidou por rejeitar convenções sociais de maneira obstinada, conseguir a atenção e a admiração de Alexandre, O Grande e por muitas vezes irritar cidadãos. Ele negava todos os luxos possíveis e tentava buscar o mais simples possível. Em Atenas, era conhecido como "O Cão" por viver nas ruas com os animais — a palavra "cinismo" antes significava pensadores rebeldes que viviam "como cães" tal qual Diógenes, mas hoje assume o significado de uma pessoa irônica, insolente, sarcástica. • Diógenes possuía poucos pertences, como o barril (onde vivia — na verdade, era um pitos, que são vasos de cerâmica grandes para guardar grãos ou vinho), uma tigela de madeira ou argila (para beber água) e uma lamparina. No entanto, ao ver animais bebendo água do rio utilizando a boca, decidiu que a tigela era um luxo desnecessário. Há uma história que conta que Diógenes costumava perambular com sua lamparina acesa durante o dia pela pólis, e quando perguntaram a ele o motivo, ele respondia "Estou a buscar um homem honesto". É isso, escrevi porque tava entediada, mas tem muuita coisa que dá pra falar sobre Diógenes. #creatorsearchinsights #diogenes #filosofia #fyp #viral

Beauty queens, we just spoke about levels in the cosmetics industry and how products get manufactured when brands work in partnership with manufacturers to create their products. With this new @Charlotte Tilbury loose powder that we got in PR, we decided to expand the conversation and think about what the 'brief' was to the lab for her to create this new loose powder. Now in product development, a brief is basically a project document meant to guide a product's development and communicate the final result a brand is looking to achieve. And if you watched our latest video on how products get made, this can happen for products at any level of manufacturing (level 1 off the shelf, level 2 tweaking already stock formulas, or level 3 custom development). Now, we can't say which level Charlotte did here in a matter a fact way, and this video isn't about that. What we CAN say after evaluating this powder and looking at the ingredients, it is 🔥🔥🔥 and is definitely giving very creamy. If you have struggled with every loose powder you've ever owned being too dry, this will be smoother and softer. Now, we don't know the price just yet, but this is one to watch in 2026. Are there other amazing powders on the market, absolutely. As a consumer, it's really a question of if you want something less drying. Sometimes I think about what would’ve happened if we’d driven down that road five minutes earlier or five minutes later😔 Would we have missed her? Would her story have been completely different? All the other cars drove right past. We didn’t have to think twice. We stopped. This was the first time I’d ever actually witnessed two dogs mating. For the first time, I wasn’t just seeing the street dog crisis🐾 I was watching exactly how another generation of puppies would come into the world, and what their future would likely look like. Born on the streets, fighting to survive, and eventually contributing to the cycle all over again💔 We made the decision the day we rescued Pemmy (yes, because of the Pemex⛽️🥲) that we would get her spayed. This world already has too many dogs waiting in shelters and on the streets, hoping someone will choose them😭 We also saw the life she still deserved to live🥹🌊✨ Instead of raising puppies… she got the chance to just be one herself💕 She found a family of her own, a sister to grow up with, and a future that looks nothing like the one we found her headed toward🏡

Understanding what dogs truly need helps them live happier, safer, and more balanced lives. 🐾 🐕 Dogs thrive with: ✅ Clear rules & boundaries 📏 ✅ Structure & routine ⏰ ✅ Training & leadership 🎓 ✅ Physical exercise 🏃‍♂️ ✅ Mental stimulation 🧠 ✅ Fair communication 🤝 ❌ Treating dogs exactly like people can sometimes lead to: ⚠️ Confusion 😵 ⚠️ Anxiety 😰 ⚠️ Poor impulse control 🚨 ⚠️ Resource guarding 🍖 ⚠️ Separation issues 😢 ⚠️ Dangerous behaviors that could have been prevented 🚫 💡 Dogs don’t think like humans—they communicate through body language, instincts, and learned behaviors.
